sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety. Candidate table included Do AI Agents Know When a Task Is Simple? (selected), PalmClaw, DenseReward, ExToken, and Agentic Botnets (duplicate live).
Read arXiv abstract, arXiv HTML full text, official GitHub README, source files, benchmark CSVs, ablations, robustness checks, and LLM-Case notes.
Explained minimum-sufficient execution, ACRR, CostModel, E3 policy control flow, MSE-Bench task tiers, and LLM-Case tool-measurement setup.
Marked simulator boundary, rule-based estimator limits, small LLM-Case sample, rename-task bias, validation-cost assumptions, and true-model variance.
Positioned the paper against ReAct/tool-use agents, adaptive computation, model routers, long-context agents, and cost-aware execution policies.
Pure Markdown article exceeds 5000 Chinese characters and includes self-contained TL;DR, formulas, pseudocode, tables, Mermaid, Figure/Table evidence reading, and limitations.
